messages:
Ashwin: Draft for Q4 capacity ask — putting this up for quick alignment. Goal: support 2.0M tokens/s p50 across hosted and dedicated by end of Q4, and raise fleet utilization target from 58% -> 70% while keeping peak latency SLA. Customers pushing: AcmeCorp needs EU capacity + Dedicated pools.
Megan: +1 on the goal. Quick q: is the 2.0M tokens/s target global or per-region?
Ashwin: global aggregate. Region targets propose EU: 25%, NA: 60%, APAC: 15%. EU bump comes from AcmeCorp + early enterprise signups.
Lucy: Procurement note — 12-16 wk lead for A100 new orders. If we want EU by start of Q4 we need to place order by end of June. :alarm_clock:
Jorge: Can we satisfy near-term EU demand with cloud burst/dedicated contracts while HW ships? e.g., commit + burst in eu-west while racks arrive.
Ashwin: Yes — proposed hybrid: reserve 120 dedicated GPUs in EU (on-prem pool) + cloud burst cap of 300 vGPUs for overflow. Long-term plan is to phase in owned fleet after 3 months.
Megan: Budget check: that hybrid looks ~30% more $ in Q4. Any room in OKRs to shift spend from Q3 to Q4?
Lucy: FYI, alternative is to buy greater mix of cheaper Ampere instances (A10/A30) for non-critical workloads and keep A100s for low-latency customer tiers. Ops can split routing by model variant.
Ashwin: Good point. Proposal A = 200 A100s (low-latency), Proposal B = 360 A30s + 80 A100s (balanced cost). Need input from product on quality delta.
Jorge: From product: AcmeCorp requires p95 latency <= 250ms for chat flow. That probably needs A100s for their peak 75% of traffic. So lean heavier A100 for Dedicated.
Megan: If p95 constraint forces more A100s, we should tighten utilization OKR to 72-75% to improve unit economics. Otherwise cost will blow out.
Ashwin: Agreed. New target: utilization 72% target, with fallback plan to auto-scale to cloud burst at 80% queue backlog threshold.
InfraBot: Procurement ticket created: #PR-8732 — "Q4 EU capacity request". Lead time estimate: 14 weeks.
Lucy: Timeline + action items: 1) Confirm customer SLOs (Product) — due 2 days. 2) Procurement: lock vendor quotes by EOW. 3) Finance: provisional budget sign-off for hybrid — due next Tue. 4) Infra: finalize routing plan and autoscale thresholds.
Jorge: I can draft the routing fallback policy: code snippet and thresholds.
Ashwin: Ping product & finance in thread, please. If finance pushes back, we'll drop EU owned fleet by one quarter and rely on cloud burst.
Megan: :thumbsup: I'll ping. Also suggest we add a KR: "Reduce reserved cloud burst costs by 10% via autoscaling/batching improvements" so engineering has a cost play to hit.
Lucy: Noted. Also we should add an eval for quantized model variants so we know perf delta before procurement finalizes.
Ashwin: OK — action owners assigned. We'll reconvene Fri 10am to sign-off final ask. Thanks everyone.
